title: She Could Not Move for Fifteen Years, Yet Her Thoughts Lifted a Coffee Cup
description:
You think fifteen years of paralysis erases movement forever! Yet one woman's silent thoughts lifted real warm coffee! This is the true story of Cathy Hutchinson's robotic arm. Here is what went wrong on that sudden day.
